items.name: Bagpipe
items.effect: The MUSICIAN ability costs 1 WP and reaches 50 meters.
items.description: A traditional wind instrument made of a bag and pipes, often used in folk music.

items.name: Drum
items.description: A percussion instrument made of a hollow body and a membrane, used in various musical styles.

items.name: Flute
items.description: A woodwind instrument made of a tube with holes, played by blowing air across an opening.

items.name: Harp
items.description: A stringed instrument played by plucking the strings, often associated with classical music.

items.name: Horn
items.description: A wind instrument made from an animal's horn or from metal, sounded by blowing into it.

items.name: Lyre
items.description: A stringed instrument with a U-shaped body, often used in ancient music.
